theorem Erdos1060.sigmaFiber_eq_canonical : ∀ {n : ℕ},
  0 < n → sigmaFiber n = {k ∈ Iic n | k * (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1) k = n} :=
fun {n} hn =>
  ext fun k =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congr (congrArg Iff sigmaFiber_eq_canonical._simp_1_1)
          (Eq.trans sigmaFiber_eq_canonical._simp_1_2
            (congrFun' (congrArg And sigmaFiber_eq_canonical._simp_1_3) (k * (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1) k = n)))))
      {
        mp := fun a =>
          And.casesOn a fun hk heq =>
            ⟨Nat.le_of_dvd hn
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => k ∣ _a) (Eq.symm heq)))
                  (dvd_mul_right k ((ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1) k))),
              heq⟩,
        mpr := fun a =>
          And.casesOn a fun hkn heq =>
            ⟨fun hk0 =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun k => k ≤ n → k * (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1) k = n → False)
                (fun hkn heq =>
                  sigmaFiber_eq_canonical._proof_1_4 hn
                    (Eq.mp
                      (congrFun'
                        (congrArg Eq (Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul 0) ArithmeticFunction.map_zero) (mul_zero 0))) n)
                      heq))
                (Eq.symm hk0) hkn heq,
              heq⟩ }
theorem Erdos1060.sigmaFiber_card_eq_canonical : ∀ {n : ℕ},
  0 < n → #(sigmaFiber n) = #({k ∈ Iic n | k * (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1) k = n}) :=
fun {n} hn =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg (fun _a => #_a = #({k ∈ Iic n | k * (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1) k = n})) (sigmaFiber_eq_canonical hn)))
    (Eq.refl #({k ∈ Iic n | k * (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1) k = n}))
